held_out.regression_repair_note: After the held-out suite passed, cumulative canaries exposed argument-correction and English noun/verb-boundary overreach. The shared classifier was narrowed without changing either R29 oracle.

verification.clippy_exception: The only exception is the already-frozen R29 diagnostic harness data constructor. Product code was refactored to satisfy clippy; changing the frozen harness would invalidate its authoritative hash.
regression_repairs: Metalinguistic suppression is scoped to quoted frames and does not erase an independent unquoted outer request.
Typed pragmatic projection runs after legacy authority reconciliation so legacy heuristics cannot overwrite the typed boundary.
Non-informational pragmatic questions are not intercepted by temporal, discourse, or dialogue QA routes.
Goal correction requires an action predicate, preserving noun-only argument corrections from the established discourse path.
English noun/verb filtering keeps `the report` nominal while allowing a verb after a clause boundary such as `No, inspect ...`.

mechanisms: PragmaticIntentGraphIR separates inferred speech-act force, goal projection, subject binding, confidence, and evidence from semantic authority.

Eight bounded intent kinds cover conventional indirect requests, preference requests, advisory suggestions, rhetorical evaluations, information questions, self offers, metalinguistic mentions, and goal corrections.
Requests may project a candidate GoalIR, suggestions remain advisory, and rhetorical, informational, self-directed, or metalinguistic forms cannot become external action execution claims.
A goal correction replaces one unambiguous active predicate with a different explicit predicate while inheriting the typed active subject; missing or competing bindings require clarification.
Shared Korean and English action morphology supplies inspect/review/verify and inflected variants without whole-sentence dispatch.
Question-routing gates preserve genuine information questions while preventing question-shaped requests, suggestions, and rhetorical evaluations from being misrouted as factual QA.
Every typed pragmatic graph forces semantic_authority=false and external_action_execution_authorized=false.
next_residual: indirect complaints and implicatures without explicit construction cues
irony and sarcasm without typed contextual evidence
social power, politeness, and multi-party commitment tracking
open-vocabulary action and role induction beyond the shared lexicon
